title: Coefficient extension normal determinant map
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal, r a natural number and f:Fin r -> A a Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence] with span(range f)=I. Let T be a submonoid and S an A-algebra localization at T, and assume span(range (A -> S composed with f))=IS. Let q:A/I -> S/IS be a ring map sending the residue of every a in A to the residue of its image in S. There exists an A-linear map nu from the normal determinant over A/I to the restricted normal determinant over S/IS [def-sc-koszul-conormal-comparison]. For every normal determinant w and r vectors v_i in A^r, the determinant pairing of nu(w) with the wedge of their image conormal vectors equals q of the pairing of w with their original conormal wedge.

source.place: Lemma 48.15.5, finite free Koszul computation, localization of the coefficient formulas

proof.text: Localization is flat by Mathlib IsLocalization.flat. Apply isKoszulRegular_of_flat to the image sequence and exists_koszul_conormal_basis to both sequences. The bases b and c are determined by their values on the generator classes, so no arbitrary data are extracted from an undetermined existence theorem.

Put e = the ordered wedge of b, z = the ordered wedge of the coordinate functionals of c, and l(w) = pairingDual(w)(e). Define nu(w) = q(l(w)) times z. Additivity follows from linearity of l and additivity of q. The identity hq on residues and map_mul prove A-linearity under the two restricted scalar actions.

Expand koszulConormalVector using Finsupp.linearCombination_apply. The generator-value conditions identify the summands with scalar multiples of b or c. Mathlib map_sum, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, Basis.coord_apply and Finsupp.single_apply compute coordinates directly, without a separate conormal-coordinate theorem. On the target, a coefficient absent from the mapped Finsupp support has image zero in S, so hq makes its residue zero as well. Apply Mathlib AlternatingMap.eq_smul_basis_det to pairingDual(w) composed with the alternating wedge map: its value on arbitrary conormal vectors is l(w) times the determinant of the residue coefficient matrix. The transpose in Basis.toMatrix disappears by Matrix.det_transpose. On the target dual coordinate wedge, pairingDual_ιMulti_ιMulti gives the determinant of the q-images of exactly the same coefficients. RingHom.map_det and hq identify this determinant with q of the source determinant. Linearity of pairingDual in its first argument and map_mul now give the requested identity. All formulas hold for r = 0 and zero quotient rings; no nontriviality hypothesis or cancellation is used.

proof_origin.place: Finite free coefficient-extension calculation; M3 evaluates on the conormal basis wedge and uses Mathlib AlternatingMap.eq_smul_basis_det instead of a normal-determinant basis. Repair: removed the duplicated private conormal_coord theorem; the two matrix computations now use Mathlib sum and basis identities directly.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_koszul_coefficient_extension_nu
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I)
    (T : Submonoid A) (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra A S]
    [IsLocalization T S]
    (hs : Ideal.span (Set.range (algebraMap A S ∘ f)) = I.map (algebraMap A S))
    (q : (A ⧸ I) →+* (S ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A S)))
    (hq : ∀ b : A, q (Ideal.Quotient.mk I b) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap A S)) (algebraMap A S b)) :
  ∃ (ν : koszulNormalDeterminant A I r →ₗ[A]
    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap A S)).obj
      (koszulNormalDeterminant S (I.map (algebraMap A S)) r)),
  ∀ (w : koszulNormalDeterminant A I r) (v : Fin r → (Fin r →₀ A)),
    exteriorPower.pairingDual (S ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A S))
      (I.map (algebraMap A S)).Cotangent r (ν w)
      (exteriorPower.ιMulti (S ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A S)) r
        (fun i ↦ koszulConormalVector S (I.map (algebraMap A S)) r
          (algebraMap A S ∘ f) hs
          ((v i).mapRange (algebraMap A S) (map_zero _)))) =
    q (exteriorPower.pairingDual (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent r w
      (exteriorPower.ιMulti (A ⧸ I) r
        (fun i ↦ koszulConormalVector A I r f hf (v i))))
